title: Replace biome dict with numpy array
details: Заменить biome (x,y) dict на 2D numpy uint8 массив индексов биомов в field.py. Ускорит доступ к биомам и уменьшит память.
notes: Replaced biome (x,y) dict with 2D numpy uint8 array in field.py. Changes: (1) __init__ - self.biomes = np.zeros((w,h), dtype=np.uint8) + self._biome_names list; (2) _assign_biomes - vectorized via np.random.choice instead of nested Python loop; (3) get_biome - array indexing self.biomes[xi,yi] with bounds check, returns self._biome_names[idx] (was dict.get); (4) analyze_biome_distribution - np.unique for counting (was O(n) iteration over dict values). All tests passed.
